name: smwpatches-stunned-bob-omb-sfx
title: Stunned Bob-Omb SFX
description:
This simple patch adds a beeping sound effect to the Bob-omb when it's stun timer is set, acting as a warning ticker that beeps faster when the Bob-omb is about to explode.

The sound effect that plays and the SFX bank can be edited with the defines in the asm file.
